subject: Collaboration Charter & MAP: kickoff with Champion and Ops
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@heartspringhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Collaboration Charter & MAP: kickoff with Champion and Ops

Hi Nora —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As discussed, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (we call it a Collaboration Charter) to align on goals, success criteria, and the timeline for a 4–6 week evaluation leading to a pilot.

Proposed objectives:
- Validate automated clinical summarization on a 2-week subset of inpatient notes
- Measure latency and throughput against 95th percentile SLOs
- Confirm integration approach for SSO and secure logging

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 1: Kickoff + access provisioning + baseline dataset exchange
- Weeks 2–3: Inference runs, quality checks, and instrumentation
- Week 4: Optimization pass (batching/quantization recommendations)
- Week 5–6: Pilot validation and decision meeting

Can you confirm: (1) that timeline looks feasible for Heartspring, (2) who your operational lead will be for access/entitlements, and (3) any hard decision dates we should respect?

I've attached a Collaboration Charter template and uploaded a working copy here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3-redwood-map-template. Marissa (AE) and Karthik (solutions) are looped in to propose a kickoff slot.

If it helps, we can do a 30-minute kickoff this coming Friday or next Tuesday. Suggested times attached in the calendar poll.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks Olga — this looks good on first pass. We're keen to validate the summarization flow and the perf SLOs.

Operational lead: adding Ryan Lopez (r.lopez@heartspringhealth.com) — he will handle access and entitlements on our side.

Hard decision dates: we have an executive review week of June 7; ideally pilot results would be available the week prior (end of May) so we can include key metrics.

Friday is tight — next Tuesday (4/20) works for us for a 30-min kickoff at 10:00am PT. I'll let Ryan confirm if that slot is ok.

—Nora
Nora Patel
VP Clinical Operations, Heartspring Health
